name: IDontKnow_6
short_caption: The robot shrugs its shoulders and opens its hands to express uncertainty.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral rest pose, the robot brings both hands inward toward the center of its chest with palms facing slightly upward. It then extends both arms outward to its sides, opening its palms fully while tilting its head slightly to the side to create a classic shrug gesture. Finally, it smoothly retracts both arms and returns its head to a centered, neutral resting position.
